# Readable README — pre-ship checklist

## Routing

- [ ] This is the human main `README.md`, not a product landing and not a file dump
- [ ] Product landing → `product-readme`; package-by-package internals → `extensive-readme`

## File

- [ ] Wrote `README.md` (not `docs/EXTENSIVE.md`)
- [ ] If extensive companion exists or was requested: banner link at the top to `docs/EXTENSIVE.md`

## Voice and length

- [ ] Curious non-specialist can follow without a glossary in the other hand
- [ ] Jargon defined in one plain sentence on first use
- [ ] Hard ideas: simple paragraph + verified blog or wiki
- [ ] Narrative finishable in one sitting (~10–20 min)
- [ ] Catalogs are short tables, not essays

## Teaching

- [ ] 2–5 ideas worth understanding (not a feature list)
- [ ] Each has problem, how, analogy, limits, verified link or an honest "no write-up yet"

## Future advancements

- [ ] At least 3, prefer 4; each grounded in this repo

## Truth

- [ ] Paths and features exist in the tree
- [ ] No invented URLs
